condition: Describe the condition and baseline severity.
intervention_protocol: Dose, device settings, sessions, intervals and co-interventions.
comparator: Control, placebo, sham or active comparator.

effect_estimates.measure: Mean difference, risk ratio or other measure

adverse_events: Events by arm, severity and serious events; write 'reported none' if explicit.
withdrawals: Counts and reasons by arm; write 'reported none' if explicit.
funding: Funding source or explicit statement that none was reported.
conflicts: Conflicts or explicit statement that none were reported.
notes: Template only: replace every placeholder after checking the complete paper.
